name: Rocking chair, Vitra Eames RAR

clearance.note: Legroom in front of the seat, and room behind for rocking

notes: Vitra Eames Plastic Armchair RE RAR, the rocking armchair (design Charles & Ray Eames, 1950), configured as in the user's picture: shell ice grey, seat cushion in a pale blue-grey, wire base powder-coated basic dark, runners in dark stained maple. W 62.5 × D 69 × H 67 cm and seat height 33 cm from Vitra's dimension drawing; the arms run level at about 56 cm, as in Vitra's photos. model.glb is generated by `npx tsx tools/models/armchair-eames-rar.ts` from its own geometry: the one-piece moulded armchair shell, with a broad, shallow seat and a large pad behind a low front edge, arm fronts that run down to the seat in one convex curve, a thick rolled rim, and a back whose top line climbs gradually from the arms into a broad dome. It started from the to-scale drawing of the rocker on dimensions.com and is matched to Vitra's photos (side and front three-quarter views, cameras fitted on the runners), the front view of Vitra's dimension drawing and the user's picture: the shell is about 56 cm deep and stands well inside the 69 cm runners, the top of its back about 8 cm in front of the runners' back ends; the runners are 42.4 cm apart. The collision parts follow the runners, the base and the shell in four layers. The clearance zone is legroom in front and room behind for rocking.
